forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4

forecasts.rationale: Repeated climate shocks make dedicated adaptation funding a core conditional priority in post-2027 CAP budgetary negotiations.

forecasts.rationale: EU policy debates favor compensating farmers for climate impacts through direct aid adaptation schemes, though general CAP budget pressures present headwinds.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Climate adaptation urgency is universally acknowledged, but competing fiscal claims and farm income subsidies make ring-fenced funds contested.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: EU fiscal constraints and competing budget priorities will challenge ring-fencing large dedicated adaptation sums.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: While climate adaptation is an urgent macroeconomic priority, tightening EU fiscal constraints hinder large dedicated ring-fenced funds.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: EU budget discussions are notoriously prone to dilution and compromise, reducing the odds of a strict EUR 10 bn ring-fenced climate allocation.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Adaptation to heat is urgent, but rigid CAP budget politics and opposing traditional direct-payment lobbies typically dilute dedicated ring-fenced envelopes.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: CAP negotiations face broad budgetary belt-tightening and competing priorities, dampening chances of massive dedicated ring-fencing.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: EU budget negotiations resist large, rigid ring-fences due to member state fiscal constraints. Expect compromise rather than a 10bn adaptation carve-out.
